title: SystemOne Trade-Off Jev Response Schema
description: Extended /v1/systemone single-forward-pass decision response containing the adapted Preference Table T_t, candidate goal evaluations, and calibrated primitive outputs including conditioned tradeoff_noul probabilities.

QualitativeSign.description: Selten Routine Model (Section 2.4) qualitative expectation per goal relative to the current aspiration or reference realization.

GoalExpectation.description: Quantitative and qualitative evaluation of a single goal g_i for a given candidate option in state x_t.

expected_level.description: Expected rubric level E[g_i(x_t)] under the model's score readout.

most_likely_level.description: Argmax discrete rubric level in {0, ..., L_i - 1}.

level_probabilities.description: Calibrated probability distribution over rubric levels 0 .. L_i - 1.

meets_aspiration.description: Whether this goal's realization satisfies the adapted aspiration level a_{i,t}.

satisfaction_probability.description: Probability P(g_i(x_t) >= a_{i,t}) summed over rubric levels >= a_{i,t}.

CandidateEvaluation.description: Full multi-goal evaluation of a candidate option against the Preference Table.

satisfices_prior_table.description: True if the candidate meets all aspiration levels in the prior table T_{t-1} (before step-t adaptation).

satisfices_adapted_table.description: True if the candidate meets all aspiration levels in the updated table T_t.

joint_satisfaction_probability.description: Calibrated probability that the candidate simultaneously satisfies all goals in T_t.

goal_expectations.description: Map from goal_id to its quantitative and qualitative expectation.

TradeOffNoulAnswer.description: Result of a tradeoff_noul primitive: returns the AAT-conditioned noul probability P(yes | x_t, T_t), feasibility status, per-goal expectations, and the updated Preference Table reference.

noul.description: Conditioned Bernoulli probability P(yes | x_t, T_t) after Aspiration Adaptation.

unconditioned_noul.description: Optional baseline unconditioned noul P(yes | x_t) (typically ~0.4-0.6 under goal conflict) for diagnostic comparison.

prior_table_feasible.description: Whether the prior aspiration vector a_{t-1} was feasible under any available candidate in state x_t.

adapted_table_feasible.description: Whether the updated aspiration vector a_t in T_t is feasible.

satisfices_adapted_table.description: Whether the queried proposition/candidate satisfies all aspiration levels in the updated table T_t.

goal_expectations.description: Per-goal quantitative and qualitative expectations for the queried proposition/candidate.

step.description: Markov step t of this response.

prior_preference_table.description: The Preference Table before step-t adaptation (either T_{t-1} passed in the request or the initialized T_0 at cold start).

preference_table.description: The updated Preference Table T_t to be passed into Markov step t+1.

prior_feasible.description: Whether at least one candidate in x_t satisfied the incoming aspiration vector.

adapted_feasible.description: Whether at least one candidate in x_t satisfies the adapted aspiration vector a_t.

satisficing_candidates.description: List of candidate_ids that satisfy all goals in the updated Preference Table T_t.

candidate_evaluations.description: Detailed multi-goal evaluations for each candidate in x_t.

answers.description: Single-pass outputs corresponding 1-to-1 with the request questions.

bartleby_noul.description: Intrinsic always-on Bartleby refusal readout P_Bartleby(refuse | x_t, T_t) in (0, 1) emitted on every forward pass without requiring a caller-supplied abstention option.

bartleby_triggered.description: True iff downward retreat hit the survival floor a^{min} (infeasible_floor) and the model refuses all candidates ('I would prefer not to.').
